headline: BIMCO Publishes New Standard Clause for Tanker Ship-to-Ship Transfers
summary: BIMCO has released a standard contractual clause to allocate operational responsibilities, costs, and risks for tanker ship-to-ship transfers and special gas operations.
why: Standardized maritime contracts clarify legal and operational liabilities for shipowners and charterers engaged in complex cargo transfers.

impacts.name: Maritime Shipping
impacts.why: Contractual frameworks streamline operational risk management across shipping firms.
